Name: Ohio Sebastian Portraits
Author: Reception
Description:
There weren't any true midwestern emo Sebastian portraits so of course I had to do it. My first quick SV mod, hope you get some enjoyment out of it. I kept the expressions as close to his default portrait sheet as I could, and this guy has very few expressions. Made it easier for me to draw at least lol. Please let me know if anything needs fixing and feel free to hit me with suggestions.

Want to use my portraits in something other than this mod? Ask me.

[b]Requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]
[/list]
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]512x1280 pixel portrait sheet for Sebastian only.
[*]My love and appreciation.
[/list]
[b]Weird Things:[/b]
[list]
[*]I don't know if it works with Portraiture. I've tried but it hasn't worked out for me.
[*][s]This probably only works for PC versions. I don't have it for mobile to test.[/s] A mobile user said it works on mobile!
[*][s]Don't ask me about anything Vortex install related because I will have no idea. I use the community NMM like a chad.[/s] A vortex user said it works with vortex!
[/list]
